detaileddescription.para: We need a 64-bit D register as an operand to VMULL. We insert the required extension here to get the vector to fill a D register.

briefdescription.para: SkipLoadExtensionForVMULL - return a load of the original vector size that does not do any sign/zero extension.

detaileddescription.para: If the original vector is less than 64 bits, an appropriate extension will be added after the load to reach a total size of 64 bits. We have to add the extension separately because ARM does not have a sign/zero extending load for vectors.

briefdescription.para: SkipExtensionForVMULL - For a node that is a SIGN_EXTEND, ZERO_EXTEND, ANY_EXTEND, extending load, or BUILD_VECTOR with extended elements, return the unextended value.

detaileddescription.para: The unextended vector should be 64 bits so that it can be used as an operand to a VMULL instruction. If the original vector size before extension is less than 64 bits we add a an extension to resize the vector to 64 bits.
